text: Elihu continued his discourse and said,
"For he has said, 'It profits a man nothing When he takes delight and is pleased with God and obeys Him.'
All flesh would perish together, And man would return to dust.
"In a moment they die, even at midnight The people are shaken and pass away, And the powerful are taken away without a [human] hand.
So that godless men would not rule Nor be snares for the people.

'For he adds rebellion [in his unsubmissive, defiant attitude toward God] to his [unacknowledged] sin; He claps his hands among us [in open mockery and contempt of God], And he multiplies his words [of accusation] against God.'"
